description: Send one change request for a generated builder app, like a chat message ("Add a contact tab", "Make the buttons rounder"). The AI edits the code, the app is checked (TypeScript and the Android and iOS bundles, or the web build), and a passing result becomes a new version with its own diff and preview. Costs builder credits (editSmall to editLarge in builder_status prices: the larger amount is held, the difference comes back when 3 files or fewer changed; all of it comes back when the change does not pass the checks). Tell the person the cost, ask, and pass confirm: true. Follow it with builder_changes. One AI step per app at a time. Developer role. Pro and Team (credits needed). On Free (design only) the call answers 403 code BUILDER_DESIGN_ONLY: tell the person building the app's code is on Pro and Team.
